```{r}
# Path to Reactome hierarchy file
reactome_hierarchy <- file.path(PROJECTPATH,  "data/enrichment/reactome_hierarchy.csv")

# Import Reactome hierarchy
df_reactome_hierarchy <- read_csv(reactome_hierarchy, show_col_types = FALSE)

# Initialize tree levels for root pathways
df_reactome_hierarchy <- df_reactome_hierarchy %>% 
  mutate(level = ifelse(is.na(ParentID), 0, NA))

# Iterate lvl down the tree
nmissing <- sum(is.na(df_reactome_hierarchy$level))
lvl <- 0
while (nmissing > 0) {
  
  df_reactome_lvl <- df_reactome_hierarchy %>% 
    filter(level == lvl)
  
  # Iterate over nodes at given level
  for (i in 1:nrow(df_reactome_lvl)){
    
    node <- df_reactome_lvl[[i, "Name"]]
    
    df_reactome_hierarchy <- df_reactome_hierarchy %>% 
      mutate(level = ifelse(is.na(Parent), 0, 
                            ifelse(Parent == node, lvl+1, level)))
    
  }
  
  nmissing <- sum(is.na(df_reactome_hierarchy$level))
  lvl <- lvl + 1
  
}

# Clean up names
df_reactome_hierarchy <- df_reactome_hierarchy %>% 
  mutate(Name = str_replace_all(Name, "  ", " "),
         Name = str_replace_all(Name, "/", " "))
```

```{r}
# Bader Reactome gene sets
module_file <- file.path(PROJECTPATH,  "data/enrichment/Human_Reactome_June_01_2025_symbol.gmt")

# Import Bader sets
df_modules <- get_module_sizes(modules = module_file)

# Clean up IDs
df_modules <- df_modules %>% 
  rename(IDBader = ID) %>% 
  mutate(ID = IDBader %>% 
           str_split_i("%", i = -1) %>% 
           str_remove("R-HSA-") %>% 
           str_remove("\\.[0-9]+"),
         ID = paste0("R-HSA-", ID)) %>% 
  mutate(Title = str_replace_all(Title, "  ", " "))

# Include hierarchy information
df_reactome <- inner_join(df_reactome_hierarchy,
                          df_modules,
                          by = "ID")

# Pathways to keep
pathway_ids_keep <- df_reactome %>% 
  filter(B > 10) %>% 
  pull(IDBader)
```

```{r}
import_enrichment_permutation <- function(file, nk_select, k_select, pathway_ids_keep, pathway_title) {
  
    df_permutation <- read_csv(file, show_col_types = FALSE)
    
    df_permutation$seed <- file |> 
      basename() |> 
      str_extract("seed_[0-9]+") |> 
      str_remove("seed_") |> 
      as.numeric()
    
    df_permutation <- df_permutation |> 
      filter(nk == nk_select, k == k_select) |> 
      filter(ID %in% pathway_ids_keep) |> 
      filter(Title == pathway_title)
    
    return(df_permutation)
  }



import_permutations_parallel <- function(
    files, nk_select, k_select, pathway_ids_keep, pathway_title,
    workers = 4L
) {
  cl <- parallel::makeCluster(workers)
  on.exit({
    parallel::stopCluster(cl)
    foreach::registerDoSEQ()
  }, add = TRUE)

  doParallel::registerDoParallel(cl)

  results <- foreach(
    file = files,
    .packages = c("readr", "dplyr", "stringr"),
    .export = "import_enrichment_permutation"
  ) %dopar% {
    import_enrichment_permutation(
      file = file,
      nk_select = nk_select,
      k_select = k_select,
      pathway_ids_keep = pathway_ids_keep,
      pathway_title = pathway_title
    )
  }

  bind_rows(results)
}
```

```{r}

import_enrichment_stat <- function(file, ids, stat = "E") {
  
  
  df <- read_csv(file, show_col_types = FALSE)
  
  df <- df |>
    filter(ID %in% ids)
  
  df <- df |> 
    unite(col = "cluster_id", c("nk", "k"), sep = "-", remove = FALSE)
  
  cluster_lvls <- df |> 
    select(nk, k, cluster_id) |> 
    distinct() |> 
    arrange(nk, k) |>
    pull(cluster_id)
  
  df <- df |> 
    mutate(cluster_id = factor(cluster_id, levels = cluster_lvls))
  
  cols <- c("ID", "cluster_id", stat)
  df <- df[,cols]
  
  mat <- df |> 
    pivot_wider(id_cols = "ID", names_from = "cluster_id", values_from = all_of(stat)) |> 
    arrange(ID) |> 
    column_to_rownames("ID") |> 
    as.matrix()
  
  return(mat)
  
}


import_enrichment_stat_parallel <- function(
    files, ids, stat = "E",
    workers = 4L
) {
  cl <- parallel::makeCluster(workers)
  on.exit({
    parallel::stopCluster(cl)
    foreach::registerDoSEQ()
  }, add = TRUE)
  
  doParallel::registerDoParallel(cl)
  
  results <- foreach(
    file = files,
    .packages = c("tidyverse"),
    .export = "import_enrichment_stat"
  ) %dopar% {
    mat <- import_enrichment_stat(
      file = file,
      ids = ids, 
      stat = stat
    )
  }
  
  enrichment_array <- simplify2array(results)
  
  return(enrichment_array)
}
```

```{r}
enrichment_file <- "cluster_pathway_enrichment.csv"
enrichment_file <- file.path(enrichment_dir, enrichment_file)
df_enrichment <- read_csv(enrichment_file, show_col_types = FALSE)

df_enrichment <- df_enrichment |>
  filter(ID %in% pathway_ids_keep)

df_enrichment <- df_enrichment |> 
  unite(col = "cluster_id", c("nk", "k"), sep = "-", remove = FALSE)

cluster_lvls <- df_enrichment |> 
  select(nk, k, cluster_id) |> 
  distinct() |> 
  arrange(nk, k) |>
  pull(cluster_id)

df_enrichment <- df_enrichment |> 
  mutate(cluster_id = factor(cluster_id, levels = cluster_lvls))

mat_enrichment_E <- df_enrichment |> 
  select(ID, cluster_id, E) |> 
  pivot_wider(id_cols = "ID", names_from = "cluster_id", values_from = "E") |> 
  arrange(ID) |> 
  column_to_rownames("ID") |> 
  as.matrix()

mat_enrichment_pvals <- df_enrichment |> 
  select(ID, cluster_id, P.Value) |> 
  pivot_wider(id_cols = "ID", names_from = "cluster_id", values_from = "P.Value") |> 
  arrange(ID) |> 
  column_to_rownames("ID") |> 
  as.matrix()

mat_enrichment_pvals_clamped <- df_enrichment |> 
  select(ID, cluster_id, P.Value) |> 
  mutate(P.Value = ifelse(P.Value < 1/1001, 1/1001, P.Value)) |>
  pivot_wider(id_cols = "ID", names_from = "cluster_id", values_from = "P.Value") |> 
  arrange(ID) |> 
  column_to_rownames("ID") |> 
  as.matrix()

mat_enrichment_qvals <- df_enrichment |> 
  select(ID, cluster_id, adj.P.Val) |> 
  pivot_wider(id_cols = "ID", names_from = "cluster_id", values_from = "adj.P.Val") |> 
  arrange(ID) |> 
  column_to_rownames("ID") |> 
  as.matrix()

mat_enrichment_NLQ <- df_enrichment |> 
  select(ID, cluster_id, NLQ) |> 
  pivot_wider(id_cols = "ID", names_from = "cluster_id", values_from = "NLQ") |> 
  arrange(ID) |> 
  column_to_rownames("ID") |> 
  as.matrix()

mat_enrichment_qvals_clamped <-  df_enrichment |> 
  mutate(P.Value = ifelse(P.Value < 1/1001, 1/1001, P.Value)) |>
  group_by(cluster_id) |>
  mutate(q.value = p.adjust(P.Value, method = "fdr")) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(ID, cluster_id, q.value) |> 
  pivot_wider(id_cols = "ID", names_from = "cluster_id", values_from = "q.value") |> 
  arrange(ID) |> 
  column_to_rownames("ID") |> 
  as.matrix()
```

```{r}
array_enrichment_E <- array(
  rep(as.vector(mat_enrichment_E), times = dim(permutation_array_E)[3]),
  dim = dim(permutation_array_E)
)

permutation_pvals <- (rowSums(permutation_array_E >= array_enrichment_E, dims = 2) + 1)/(dim(permutation_array_E)[3] + 1)

permutation_qvals <- apply(permutation_pvals, MARGIN = 2, FUN = p.adjust, method = "BH")

permutation_NLQ <- -log10(permutation_qvals)

min(permutation_qvals, na.rm = TRUE)
```

# Anatomical segregation of pathways

```{r}
max_med_diff <- function(x, na.rm = FALSE) {
  x_max <- max(x, na.rm = na.rm)
  x_med <- median(x, na.rm = na.rm)
  return(x_max - x_med)
}

compute_empirical_pvalues <- function(x, samples) {
  
  if (is.null(dim(samples))) {
    n_dims <- 1
    n_samples <- length(samples)
    x_rep <- rep(x, n_samples)
    pvals <- (sum(samples >= x_rep) + 1)/(n_samples + 1)
  } else {
    n_dims <- length(dim(samples))
    n_samples <- dim(samples)[n_dims]
    x_rep <- array(rep(as.vector(x), times = n_samples),
                   dim = dim(samples))
    pvals <- (rowSums(samples >= x_rep, dims = n_dims-1) + 1)/(n_samples + 1)
  }
  
  return(pvals)
}
```


## Single nk, single pathway

```{r}
nk <- 8
pathway <- "Protein-protein interactions at synapses"

pathway_id <- df_enrichment |> 
  filter(Title == pathway) |> 
  pull(ID) |> 
  unique()

idx_pathway <- which(rownames(mat_enrichment_E) == pathway_id)

idx_clusters <- which(str_detect(colnames(mat_enrichment_E), paste0(nk, "-")))

E_pathway_nk <- mat_enrichment_E[idx_pathway, idx_clusters]

E_max_med_diff <- max_med_diff(x = E_pathway_nk)

samples_E_pathway_nk <- permutation_array_E[idx_pathway, idx_clusters,]

E_max_med_diff_samples <- apply(samples_E_pathway_nk, MARGIN = 2, FUN = max_med_diff, na.rm = TRUE)

pval <- compute_empirical_pvalues(x = E_max_med_diff, samples = E_max_med_diff_samples)

plt_title <- paste0("Cluster solution (nk): ", nk, "\nPathway: ", pathway)
plt_caption <- paste0("Empirical p-value: ", round(pval, 4))

plt <- tibble(x = E_max_med_diff_samples) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = x)) + 
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = E_max_med_diff, col = "red") +
  labs(x = "Max(E) - Median(E)",
       title = plt_title,
       caption = plt_caption) +
  theme_bw()

outfile <- "enrichment_max_med_nk_8_PPI.pdf"
pdf(file = outfile,
    width = unit(6, "in"),
    height = unit(6, "in"))
print(plt)
invisible(dev.off())
```

## Single nk, all pathways

How do we multiplex this?


```{r}
# Select cluster solution
nk <- 8
idx_clusters <- which(str_detect(colnames(mat_enrichment_E), paste0(nk, "-")))
mat_E_nk <- mat_enrichment_E[,idx_clusters]

# Remove pathways with all NA
idx_all_missing <- rowSums(is.na(mat_E_nk)) == nk
mat_E_nk <- mat_E_nk[!idx_all_missing,]

# Compute true max-med diff
E_max_med_diff <- apply(mat_E_nk, MARGIN = 1, FUN = max_med_diff, na.rm = TRUE)

# Filter samples for pathways and clusters
samples_E_nk <- permutation_array_E[!idx_all_missing, idx_clusters, ]
E_max_med_diff_samples <- apply(samples_E_nk, MARGIN = c(1,3), FUN = max_med_diff, na.rm = TRUE)

E_max_med_diff_pvals <- compute_empirical_pvalues(x = E_max_med_diff, samples = E_max_med_diff_samples)

tibble(pvals = E_max_med_diff_pvals) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = -log10(pvals))) + 
  geom_histogram() + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = -log10(0.05), col = "red") + 
  theme_bw()
```

## All nk, all pathways

```{r}
compute_max_med_statistics <- function(enrichment, enrichment_samples, nk_range = 2:10) {
  
  mat_stats <- matrix(data = 0, nrow = nrow(enrichment), ncol = length(nk_range))
  mat_pvals <- matrix(data = 0, nrow = nrow(enrichment), ncol = length(nk_range))
  list_samples <- vector(mode = "list", length = length(nk_range))
  for (i in 1:length(nk_range)) {
    
    nk <- nk_range[i]
    
    message(paste0("On nk = ", nk))
    
    idx_clusters <- which(str_detect(colnames(enrichment), paste0(nk, "-")))
    enrichment_nk <- enrichment[,idx_clusters]
    
    # Compute true max-med diff
    stats <- apply(enrichment_nk, MARGIN = 1, FUN = max_med_diff, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    # Filter samples for pathways and clusters
    enrichment_samples_nk <- enrichment_samples[, idx_clusters, ]
    stat_samples <- suppressWarnings(
      apply(enrichment_samples_nk, MARGIN = c(1,3), FUN = max_med_diff, na.rm = TRUE)
      )
    
    pvals <- compute_empirical_pvalues(x = stat, samples = stat_samples)
    
    mat_stats[,i] <- stats
    mat_pvals[,i] <- pvals
    list_samples[[i]] <- stat_samples
    
  }
  
  colnames(mat_stats) <- colnames(mat_pvals) <- paste0("nk", nk_range)
  rownames(mat_stats) <- rownames(mat_pvals) <- rownames(enrichment)
  names(list_samples) <- paste0("nk", nk_range)
  
  return(list(stats = mat_stats,
              pvals = mat_pvals,
              samples = list_samples))
  
}
```

```{r}
tmp <- compute_max_med_statistics(enrichment = mat_enrichment_E,
                                  enrichment_samples = permutation_array_E,
                                  nk_range = 4:10)
```
```{r}
df_pvals <- as_tibble(tmp$pvals, rownames = "ID")

df_pvals_long <- df_pvals |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = -ID, names_to = "nk_name", values_to = "pvals") 

ggplot(df_pvals_long, aes(x = -log10(pvals))) + 
  geom_histogram() +
  facet_wrap(~nk_name)
```

```{r}
n_samples <- 250
n_samples <- nrow(df_pvals)

set.seed(123)
plt <- df_pvals |> 
  sample_n(size = n_samples)  |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = -ID, names_to = "nk_name", values_to = "pvals") |> 
  mutate(nk = as.numeric(str_remove(nk_name, "nk"))) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = nk, y = -log10(pvals), group = ID)) + 
  geom_line(col = "grey50", linewidth = 0.05) + 
  geom_point() + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), col = "red", linetype = "dashed") + 
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(1, 20, by = 1)) + 
  labs(x = "Cluster solution (nk)",
       y = "-log10(p)",
       title = "Max(E) - Median(E) p-values for all pathways") + 
  theme_bw()

outfile <- "enrichment_max_med_pvalues.pdf"
pdf(file = outfile,
    width = unit(10, "in"),
    height = unit(6, "in"))
print(plt)
invisible(dev.off())
```
